mechanism_narrative: A current federal funds rate below 0.5% (as of t-1mo) compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS (as of t-1mo) is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.5% (as of t-1mo), it signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE (as of t-1mo) exceeds 6.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% as of t-1mo) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 6.5% as of t-1mo) indicates monetary policy response to economic distress, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS (as of t-1mo) is below 0.5% AND UNRATE (as of t-1mo) exceeds 6.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 260 (as of t-1mo), it indicates persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, reducing equity risk appetite and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL (as of t-1mo) exceeds 260, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current non-farm payrolls (as of t-1mo) predicts positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns due to strong labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS (as of t-1mo) exceeds 140,000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400 (as of t-2mo), it indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST (as of t-2mo) exceeds 1400, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of housing starts above 1400 (HOUST as of t-2mo) and industrial production above 100 (INDPRO as of t-2mo) indicates strong economic activity supporting corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST (as of t-2mo) exceeds 1400 AND INDPRO (as of t-2mo) exceeds 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
